HomePage.title: Software Engineer
HomePage.intro: I studied Computer Science at the University of London and earned my degree there. My focus is on Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and React Native, alongside data analysis and AI/machine learning. I love picking up new technologies, and I'm always looking to grow further as an engineer.

ProjectsPage.title: Personal Projects
ProjectsPage.nailSalonDescript: This is a mobile application built with React Native. It streamlines the appointment scheduling process for a nail salon. Users can create an account, book appointments, manage their bookings, and cancel when necessary. It is built with a focus on user experience and modern UI design
ProjectsPage.calculator: This project is a calculator app with the functionality that help solve simple math. Its inspired by widgets found on smartphones. In this project I was more focused on responsive design
ProjectsPage.weatherAppDescript: I have created a weather app that retrieves real-time weather data from the Weather API. The app allows users to search for any city or country of their choice and displays detailed weather information, including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather conditions. The app features a clean and user-friendly interface, making it easy to enter a location and quickly view the weather forecast. The data is fetched dynamically using API calls, ensuring up-to-date information.
ProjectsPage.birdClassificationDescript: In this project I used a convolutional neural network to build a model which takes images as inputs and through its deep convolutional layers extracts the features of this image and classify it as one of the classes or species through the multi-class classification system of this model.
ProjectsPage.foodAppDescript: The Food App is a small project built with React Native in Expo. It simulates the user experience of selecting a restaurant and viewing its menu. The app provides a simple and intuitive interface for browsing restaurant options and exploring available dishes
ProjectsPage.portfolioAppDescript: This is the website you are currently visiting. I built it using modern web technologies to ensure a smooth and responsive experience. It is designed to be fully accessible and user-friendly on a variety of devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones. No matter what device you are using, the layout adjusts seamlessly to provide an optimal viewing experience
ProjectsPage.metaDescription: A selection of personal projects by Gerald Kanzara, including mobile apps, web apps, and machine learning projects.

AboutPage.title: About Me
AboutPage.bio: I'm a software engineer with a BSc in Computer Science from the University of London, driven by a strong appetite for learning and adapting quickly to new tools and environments. Through academic and personal projects I've built experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, React Native, and Python, including a university research project applying Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), REST and GraphQL APIs, and SQL to data analysis. In June 2026 I completed Kikagaku's AI/DX Human Resource Development Program, a METI-certified "Re-skilling" course covering data analysis, machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing. Years spent teaching English also shaped how I work — explaining complex ideas clearly, communicating across cultures, and solving problems on the fly — skills I bring directly into team-based software development.
AboutPage.educationCs: BSc Computer Science — University of London (2020 – 2024)
AboutPage.experienceBerlitzDescription: Teaching business and conversational English to students ranging from university level to working professionals, including corporate training programs. Tailoring instruction to individual goals, giving structured feedback, and communicating across cultures built the same skills I apply to explaining technical work and collaborating on a team.
AboutPage.experienceIttoDescription: Taught English conversation to students from elementary through high school age, planning lessons, tracking progress, and coordinating with parents and international staff. Sharpened my ability to break problems down and communicate solutions clearly to different audiences.
